text: Fill in the missing term or value in each sentence about dietary components.
questions: Fat provides *9:Carbohydrate and protein each give 4 kcal per gram.* kcal per gram of energy, more than double the yield of carbohydrate or protein.
Cereal protein is limiting in the essential amino acid *lysine:This is why cereals alone give incomplete protein.*, while pulse protein is limiting in methionine.
When rice and dal are eaten together, each covers the other's limiting amino acid; this effect is called *mutual supplementation:A cornerstone of Indian vegetarian nutrition.*.
Nitrogen balance is *positive:Negative balance occurs in starvation, fever and burns.* during growth and pregnancy, when protein synthesis exceeds breakdown.
Egg protein is used as the *reference:Because egg supplies all essential amino acids in adequate proportions.* standard for comparing the quality of other dietary proteins.

overallFeedback.feedback: Fat's high energy density (9 kcal/g versus 4 for carbohydrate or protein) explains why even small amounts of oil greatly increase a meal's calories. Mutual supplementation — cereals covering pulses' methionine gap and vice versa for lysine — is the biochemical basis of the traditional Indian rice-and-dal combination.
